newsitem.title: USA: Explosion rocks Shell plant near Houston.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks Shell plant near Houston.

text.p: A powerful explosion and fire ripped through a Shell Oil Co. plant near Houston Sunday, but no one was seriously injured, police said.

The explosion occurred shortly after 10 a.m. CDT (11 a.m. EDT) in the petrochemical section of the plant in the Houston suburb of Deer Park, and local residents were told to turn off their air conditioners, close all doors and windows and stay inside.
The plant produces ethylene and propylene, which are extremely flammable feedstocks for other chemical products, but company officials said the danger had passed.

"The fire is contained. We have industrial hygienists in the area and they are not detecting any levels of toxins outside the plant," Lynn Elsenhans, president and chief executive officer of the Deer Park plant, told Reuters.

"Everyone has been accounted for and there are no serious injuries," Elsenhans said. She said one employee was taken to the hospital with chest pains but it was not clear whether they were linked to the blast.
The cause of the explosion was under investigation.
